description: This file defines core classes and functions for lazy tensor operations in the torch::lazy namespace, including LazyTensor and SymNodeImpl, with methods for tensor creation, data handling, IR management, and conversion between lazy tensors and ATen tensors.

classes.name: SymNodeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of symbolic node in the lazy tensor graph.

classes.name: LazyTensor
classes.description: Core class representing a lazy tensor with methods for data management, IR handling, and tensor conversion.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static methods to create LazyTensor instances from tensors, IR values, or data handles.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: ToTensor
methods.description: Converts the lazy tensor to a regular at::Tensor.

methods.name: SetTensor
methods.description: Assigns a tensor value to the lazy tensor.

methods.name: UpdateFromTensor
methods.description: Updates the lazy tensor from a given tensor.

methods.name: GetDataHandle
methods.description: Fetches the data handle behind the tensor, executing graph if needed.

methods.name: SetIrValue
methods.description: Sets the IR value for the tensor.

methods.name: ApplyPendingGraph
methods.description: Executes pending graph operations to update tensor data.
